i2.text: No one checks who launched it.

l2.text: Every token that comes through here gets tested.

l3.text: Every call, sealed on a public ledger.

l5.text: Hits and misses, published by name.

l6.text: Behind every token is a wallet.

l7.text: We keep a record on those too.

l8.text: And before an AI agent buys, one call.
